content.title: Reviewer Relationships with Industry and Other Entities (Relevant)—2016 ACC/AHA Guideline Focused Update on Duration of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in Patients with Coronary Artery Disease (December 2015)
content.summary: The table lists various reviewers, their roles, affiliations, and any relationships they have with industry and other entities. It highlights potential conflicts of interest in the context of guidelines for dual antiplatelet therapy in coronary artery disease.
